# Paper Dreamz by Ruchi Mishra

> Paper Dreamz is a luxury handmade stationery and gifting brand from New Delhi, India, founded by designer Ruchi Mishra in 2010. It creates handcrafted envelopes (shagun lifafas), keepsakes and bespoke gifts for weddings, baby ceremonies, festivals and other celebrations, finished with gold foil, hand-poured wax seals, pearls and velvet.

## What we make

- Luxury envelopes and shagun lifafas: floating pearl, baby, wedding / engagement / roka, floral, traditional, festive, religious, and gold / silver coin envelopes
- Gift tags
- Gold / silver coin boxes and cash boxes
- Handmade baby books and albums, keepsake diaries, frames and personalised message cards
- Custom and bulk orders for weddings, corporate and festive gifting, with names, initials, monograms and dates

## Ordering

- Custom lifafa suites start at a minimum order of 50 pieces, with bulk pricing from 100 pieces.
- Every custom order includes a digital mockup for approval before hand-crafting begins.
- For destination weddings, order at least 8–10 weeks in advance.
- Orders and enquiries are taken on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917669006999
